## Changes
- Home has a "Your walls" row: your saved Media Walls with their pictures, newest first. Click one to open it, or "+ New wall" to put one together. "All walls..." opens the gallery.
- Once two or more of the Next steps are done, the card shrinks to one line ("3 of 4 next steps done. Left: ...") with the next step's button. "Show all" brings the full card back.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
